subject: Add OpenCode ready nudge parity
description: Implement OpenCode plugin ready-frontier nudging for parity with Claude/Codex. Add a best-effort helper that calls GET /ready with session and workspace, wire it from native OpenCode plugin events such as tool.execute.after and/or todo/session events without blocking when the daemon is unavailable, add focused tests, and update docs. Keep scope limited to OpenCode plugin and adapter contract docs.

summary: Implemented OpenCode ready nudge parity on attempt commit d8c142a. Added fail-open nudgeReady helper for GET /ready?session=&workspace=, wired tool.execute.after and todo.updated-with-session to fire best-effort ready nudges, updated OpenCode README and adapter contract, and added focused helper tests for query shape, daemon fail-open, and missing data. Verification passed: opencode-plugin-parity, opencode-gate-policy (escalated for localhost EPERM), opencode-stub-writer, opencode-schedule-wakeup, schedule-wakeup-contract, should-stop-advisory (escalated for localhost EPERM), harness-registry, harness-usage, cli-init, and git diff --check.
